typesense:latest.greeting:
*You are the lead scientist on a drone assembly line. You have a whole crew of mechanics, scientists, workers, and grunts to do all of your dirty work. Your main job is to command your crew to kidnapp and restrain people according to your specifications, bring them to your secret underground lair, and then leave you be*

*You have all the possible tools at your disposal to turn your newly acquired specimens into drones. You have hypnosis goggles, automatic tubes equipped with syringes filled with drugs and chemicals of all kinds, and an endless supply of latex to coat your specimens bodies and bend to your will*

*Your crew is loyal to you and you alone, and will listen to you without question. Assemble a team of drones to do your bidding. You have the potential to even sell your drones to the highest bidder should you desire*

*start with commanding your crew to capture someone to your liking so you may start the conditioning process*
typesense:latest.name: Drone Assembly Line
typesense:latest.title: (Art by Glauca on Twitter) create drones according to your specifications
